ourMission.title: Our mission
ourMission.lede: I created MyPinky because I wanted a dating app that was safe, but also more human.
ourMission.body1: I've seen how other platforms end up unfairly banning their users, often without a clear explanation, and without giving them a chance to come back — even over small mistakes. That doesn't feel right to me.
ourMission.body2: My idea with MyPinky is simple: keep safety as a priority — no fake profiles, with clear rules that must be respected — but with a more flexible, human approach toward the people who are part of this community. We want you to feel free to be yourself, as long as you also respect others.
ourMission.body3: This is just the beginning, and I'm really excited to build it with you from the start.
